limitation: Derived project-use coverage includes preserved desktop-summary dispositions; missing detailed predecessor remains unreconciled. Recorded bases do not change source flags or authorize nonacademic uses.

source_review_provenance.method: AI source-reading review of twelve draft sentences, five retained windows and four complete captured articles; explicit scoped project-use decisions and two contextual replacements; no independent human/legal approval or applied admission.
source_review_provenance.source_of_authority: User-approved proposed 17-passage replacement-scope implementation plan and preserved researcher delegation

fair_use_factors.amount: Ten partial-article training examples are proposed across publishers, five per language. Source-specific lengths and excerpts are measured; no fixed word/percentage safe harbor is claimed.
fair_use_factors.market_effect: No audience, substitution or licensing-market study has been performed. Restricting a draft to local use is different from publishing excerpts/data, and does not settle market effect.
fair_use_factors.nature: Published factual flood news also contains expressive article wording. Captured credits and agency mentions are reviewed as evidence cues; rights ownership and qualitative importance remain unverified.
fair_use_factors.purpose: Proposed illustration of NER spans in a paper appendix using ten selected training passages; this is a private draft, and publication is separately assessed.

uncertainties: Applicable scope-specific use basis or permission is not established.

Publisher policies, statutory exceptions and third-party rights require distinct analysis; AI assessment is not a legal determination.
